name: Text to Video
intro: This is Text to Video in SmartVideo, a simple starting page where you can browse video models and example prompts, then carry your choice into Video Studio.

features.video-generation-reimagined-cards: The Video Generation Reimagined cards give you a quick summary of what Video Studio offers, from cinematic quality to durations and resolutions. They're information only, not buttons.
features.get-started-free: Get Started Free opens Video Studio right away. It's the fastest route from this page to the video generator if you already know what you want to make.
features.gtm-boost: GTM Boost turns a rough marketing idea into a conversion focused prompt. Choose your angle, audience and goal, then apply it to open Video Studio with the prompt waiting.
features.available-models: Available Models shows featured video models as cards. Click one to open Video Studio, and check its model button afterward to confirm the model you wanted is selected.
features.example-prompts: Example Prompts give you five ready ideas, like a drone shot over a city at sunset. Click Try this to drop the prompt into Video Studio and tweak it.
features.start-creating-videos: At the bottom, Start Creating Videos opens Video Studio once you've browsed. Treat this page as a menu, and set duration and ratio over in the studio.

outro: Now you know your way around Text to Video. Choose a model or a prompt, and Video Studio is ready for you.
